title: Dashboard Features, Form Validations, and Notification Fixes
summary: Implemented password change functionality, enforced strict form requirements for campaigns and creator applications, fixed broken notification links via code updates and a DB migration, and enhanced homepage routing with deep-linking support.
details: 1. Added password change feature to SettingsTab (frontend & backend route). 2. Made all fields mandatory in CreatorApplicationModal and CreateCampaign (all phases). 3. Fixed incorrect notification links in campaignRoutes.js and paymentRoutes.js (e.g., my-campaigns -> my-projects). 4. Executed a migration script (fixNotificationLinks.js) to correct 8 existing broken links in MongoDB. 5. Updated homepage banner buttons to route to /explore with type=reward/charity filters. 6. Added a 'Coming Soon' modal for Forgot Password on the Login page. 7. Created SETUP_GUIDE.md for cross-device setup.
